note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Two complete desks of the same size share the same original decision card, strip, calendar and hands; the single changed fact is that desk B receives the supplied confirmatory card (brought in by hand and set square beside the original). The same strip is then laid on both desks in parallel. A and B are shown with equal weight; no winner, score or outcome is drawn and the printed results never change. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts and comparisonLabels are editable. Coordinator decision (2026-10-05, precedent LAW-0211): at 1:1 only (default, baseline, baseline-es) key text may be >= 18 px and title/reasons >= 16.5 px as a documented limit; 16:9 and 9:16 keep 19.5 px. Under the same decision and the standing rule of 2026-09-26, the long-labels-stress card fields (roles, titles, references, reasons, results, shared facts) are capped to the longest values that fit 1:1 at >= 16 px; every field stays longer than the baseline.
